dict.string: Accrue connects to your Bluetooth heart-rate strap during workouts to show your heart rate and zones.
Accrue reads your heart rate, calories, distance and VO₂ max to show zones and progress for your workouts.
Accrue saves your workouts to Apple Health, with their time, calories and distance.
Accrue uses your location during an outdoor run, walk or ride to measure distance and pace. It is not used at other times.
